newsitem.title: USA: Sylvan to buy National Education for $750 mln.
newsitem.headline: Sylvan to buy National Education for $750 mln.

text.p: Sylvan Learning Systems Inc said Wednesday it had agreed to buy National Education Corp for $750 million in stock.
Sylvan, which runs 650 tutoring and trade schools, said it will issue 0.58 share for each National Education share.
The deal values National Education at $20.37 a share, a 20 percent premium, Sylvan said.
The transaction, which is expected to be completed by the end of the second quarter, is seen increasing the combined companies' earnings per share in 1997, the companies said.
The acquisition will create a national network of schools that can help students from kindergarten to adulthood, the companies said.

"This will place the combined company in an excellent position to increase its business in existing markets and to penetrate new markets within the trillion dollar worldwide education services field," said Doug Becker, Sylvan chief executive.
